verdict.rationale: Skills ship with distinct per-skill descriptions (tdd, grilling, triage, etc.) and a discovery skill ('Find out which skill to use for the situation you are in') implying some intent for context-based selection, but most evidence shows skills invoked explicitly via slash commands (e.g. /grill-with-docs) or 'use them every time' rather than agent-driven automatic activation from task context. Missing for 10: evidence that SKILL.md descriptions are engineered/tested for automatic trigger accuracy, and any hands-on report confirming the agent correctly auto-selects skills without explicit invocation.
